This are my initial questions and feedback::::::

Walid:

Well-structured.
The font sizes are exactly as they should be.

Here are my initial thoughts and feedback. I'll take a closer look later through a more technical lens.
And, of course, I'll provide an estimate.

Questions
The font sizes specified after the slash (55/65) refer to line height, right?

Shouldn't we have a 16:9 background image with text over it for the front page, section dividers, or paragraph slides?

Typically, the logo isn't included on every single slide—is that what is preferred here?

The placeholder images in the splash are meant to function as a mask, right?

The spacing between the heading and body text on slides 13 and 14 isn't identical. Is that intentional?

To Be Investigated
I need to think a bit more about slides 2 and 11. A bullet point with highlighted text and body text underneath might not be possible if the user needs to be able to add multiple bullets themselves. Unless you limit it to just two, which I assume you don't want to do.

Design Questions
There are many places where the text is perfectly designed in relation to the grid.
However, when the user adds one bullet point instead of two, it will obviously look different.
And if they add more than two bullets, the text size will shrink to make room for it.

This is where we encounter real-world usage.
Let's keep an eye on that and see how it plays out.
